Reverse Image Search App : AI Visual Search & Finder

Reverse Image Search lets you search using a photo instead of words. Upload any picture or paste one from your gallery, and run a quick reverse image search to find matching images, visually similar results, and detailed context about the photo in seconds. It’s the simplest way to do image search when you only have a picture.

You can also learn what’s inside the image. The app detects objects like products, animals, plants, places, faces, and logos, so your image search gives meaning, not just matches. If the photo contains text, you can translate text from photos with built-in OCR and instantly copy or understand what it says.
Key Features
 -Reverse image search from Camera, Gallery, Files, or Clipboard

 -AI Visual Finder to recognize objects, products, plants, animals, places, and more

 -Translate text from photos with built-in OCR for quick, accurate extraction


 -High-resolution finder to locate clearer or original versions
 -Search history to revisit past reverse image search results anytime
 -Save & download results to your device with one tap
 -Fast, lightweight experience designed for quick searches
 -Privacy controls — clear your image search history whenever you want


Use cases

 -Verify social media photos, memes, and news screenshots with reverse image search

 -Check dating profile pictures to avoid catfishing using image search

-Find the name of a plant, pet, or landmark by running reverse image search

 -Shop smarter: do an image search on a product photo to compare prices

 -Locate wallpapers or high-res versions with reverse image search

 -Discover similar styles, outfits, or home décor through image search

 -Track down reused or stolen content with reverse image search
